response.reasoning_text:
Cholesky: outer i loop has loop-carried dependency (A[i][i] depends on previous rows). Can parallelize inner j loop (each A[i][j] independent after rows < i done). Inner k loop is reduction-like but writes A[i][j]; parallelizing j with each thread doing its own k loop is fine. Then the diagonal update depends on A[i][j] for j<i, so need barrier before i==i case; do it sequentially or with inner parallel for over k with reduction? A[i][i] -= A[i][k]*A[i][k] is reduction; could parallel for with reduction(+:...)? It's subtraction of product; can restructure: sum reduction then A[i][i] -= sum. Simpler: parallel for j with schedule(static), then diagonal loop sequential.
